name: Soundscape
description: Experience the world through sound. AI-powered immersive soundscapes anchored in real locations. Record, share, and discover the sonic texture of cities.
crossPromoDescription: Immersive city soundscapes — AI-powered audio experiences anchored in real locations worldwide.
llmsDescription: Soundscape is an AI-powered immersive soundscape platform that anchors real-world recordings to geographic locations. Users record, share, and discover the sonic texture of cities through a vinyl-inspired interactive player.
